instructions: A tank fills at 5 liters/minute from pipe A and 3 liters/minute from pipe B, both open together. It drains at 4 liters/minute when the drain is open. If all three (A, B, drain) are open together, how many minutes to fill an empty 32-liter tank? Click your answer, then click Finish.

stimulus.prompt: Fill rate: +5+3 L/min, drain: -4 L/min, all open together. Empty tank = 32 L. Minutes to fill?
